text_block_list.text:
During a training session with Meisho
Doto, three
students grab our attention.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, but would you let Meisho
Doto go
partner running with us?
text_block_list.name: Student A
choice_data_list: I'm fine with it... but what do you think?

text_block_list.text: Eek?! Um, huh?! Well, th-the thing is...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
...I'm really happy you asked, but are
you sure
you want someone like me?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
We totally wanna run against you! I
wanna learn
from that go-getter attitude
of yours!
text_block_list.name: Student B

text_block_list.text:
B-but, I haven't done anything special to
warrant
this praise...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
That's not true! I've seen the way you
always hold
on towards the end of the
race. Just when you're
surrounded on all
sides, you give it one final spurt
to break
free... it's really something!
text_block_list.name: Student C

text_block_list.text: Eep! Oh, th-thank you very much!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Well, if you don't mind having me,
then... I would
be happy to join you!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Yesss! I'll go get ready, okay?!
text_block_list.name: Student A

text_block_list.text:
To be invited on a partner run is like a
dream
come true... And it's all thanks to
you, Trainer...
hehe.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
